conventions.section_A: 44W (glamu=-44.04), U-grid, NBC transport = -sum(u<0) e2u e3u from coast (2.42S) to 1.67N (ORIG mean zero crossing of 0-1000 m integrated u), positive westward, Sv
conventions.section_B: 5.035N, V-grid, NBC transport = +sum(v>0) e1v e3v from coast (52.5W) to 47.92W, positive northward, Sv
conventions.energy: T-point KE, weights e1t*e2t*e3t, box 70W-30W 5S-30N; EKE = KE of daily anomalies from 31-day mean
conventions.note: Only January 1993 is available: no seasonal cycle can be computed; the 31-day mean and 10-degree smoothed fields are used as proxies for the large-scale / low-frequency signal.

filter_version: v3 fixed (vector div-rot U,V with e3f in the curl term; scalar-filtered rigid-lid W)

v1_vs_v3.coastal_band: wet T points within 50 km of land, 70W-30W 5S-30N, level 0 (0.5 m)

large_scale.note: Only January 1993 is available: no seasonal cycle can be computed; the 31-day mean and 10-degree smoothed fields are used as proxies for the large-scale / low-frequency signal.
